task.Description: the type of task block the event was part of

task_block_on.Description: whether the event represents the start of a new task block

Levels.1: the event represents the start of a new task block
Levels.0: the event does not represent the start of a new task block

image.Description: the specific stimulus displayed on screen
image.Coding: the first letter corresponds to fame (A-anonymous; F-famous); the second letter corresponds to domain (F-face; P-place); the number corresponds to the stimulus ID.

novelty.Description: whether the stimulus was displayed before (as part of an N-back sequence)

Levels.Novel: the stimulus has not been displayed before
Levels.Repeat: the stimulus has been displayed before

domain.Description: the cognitive domain to which the stimulus belongs - whether social or spatial cognition

Levels.Place: the stimulus is an image of a place
Levels.Face: the stimulus is an image of a face

fame.Description: the fame status of the stimulus

Levels.Famous: the stimulus is an image of a famous face/place
Levels.Anonymous: the stimulus is an image of an unknown face/place

fame_rating.Description: the fame rating provided by the participant for the stimulus in a post-scan survey using a 7-point Likert scale

fame_check.Description: whether the fame rating provided by the participant for the stimulus matched the intended fame designation

Levels.1.0: the participant recognized the famous face/place as famous (fame rating >= 4)
Levels.0.0: the participant did not recognized the famous face/place as famous (fame rating < 4)

task_relevance.Description: whether the stimulus was relevant to the selective attention N-back task

Levels.Relevant: the stimulus was relevant to the ongoing selective attention task, requiring assessing N-back matches
Levels.Irrelevant: the stimulus was irrelevant to the ongoing selective attention task and did not require assessing N-back matches

response_time.Description: response latency relative to stimulus onset

accuracy.Description: whether the participant's response was accurate (note that, during the N-back task, whether a response is considered accurate or not depends on the selective attention task)
